name: 95320 · Escalon, CA
findings: ZIP 95320 (Escalon) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95320 (Escalon) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95320 (Escalon) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
